children: Overview
China property developer's half-year revenue fell 62% yr/yr
Net loss attributable to owners widened compared to prior year period
Gross profit dropped 92% yr/yr amid weaker contracted sales
Outlook
Ronshine China plans to accelerate property pre-sales, sales and receivables collection to ease liquidity pressure
Group seeks renewed and new financing while pursuing a holistic solution with overseas creditors for debt obligations
Ronshine China expects China's property market to remain in deep adjustment and optimisation in H2
Result Drivers
CONTRACTED SALES DROP - Co said contracted sales fell 39% yr/yr, contributing to lower revenue and gross profit
MARGIN PRESSURE - Gross margin fell to 5.89% from 26.61%, primarily due to lower average gross profit margins on delivered projects
SUBSIDIARY DISSOLUTION LOSSES - Other net losses widened to RMB480.83 mln from RMB37.14 mln, primarily due to higher losses from dissolving subsidiaries
